items.title: Nvidia stock reacts as Huang admits to an affair with a Chinese spy, Anthropic moves ahead with IPO
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman, Jake Conley, and Pras Subramanian, break down the top market stories of the day, including Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang, admitting to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. Nvidia's stock drops as US national security and US-China relations come into sharper focus. Plus, the latest on the Anthropic IPO as the company targets a $1.5 trillion valuation.

items.title: Did Trump know about Jensen Huang? What Congress will be looking at
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) stock is under fire over CEO Jensen Huang's acknowledged affair with Alice Wong, who is suspected of being a spy for Chinese intelligence. The company's board is launching a probe into the affair. "Chip War" author Chris Miller chats with Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley about his expectations for the US government's response and Congress's closed-door briefing.
